snapshot_source: Full local read-only 94-repository collection retained outside this index; digest below.
method: Resolve latest published Release tag to commit, compare that commit to repository main HEAD captured in the 94-repository snapshot. No GitHub re-query for this matrix.
category_rules: documentation=项目文档 and top-level docs; build_and_layout=Build, 构建.py, 构建配置.json, .gitignore; workflow=.github/workflows; verification_or_build_code=tests, checks, scripts, tools, verification, backend.py, verify.py and other code paths in the original conservative classifier; other=remaining paths. Counts classify paths, not code semantics.
limitations: This is a fixed 2026-10-05 snapshot, not a live current-state claim. Different latest tag and HEAD means the released commit predates current tree; it does not alone prove a CVP eligibility failure or require binary assets.
